segments.name: Europe & International
segments.description: Sells oatmilk and other plant-based dairy goods to retail and foodservice customers in Europe and other international markets.
segments.evidence: The goodwill is allocated to the Europe & International segment.

segments.name: North America

segments.evidence: The Chief Executive Officer assesses the operating performance based on the Group's three operating segments: Europe & International, North America and Greater China.
